title: ManhattanGrid intersection detection and direction selection
description:
Implement intersection behavior for ManhattanGrid:
- detect_intersection() method to check if node is at a grid intersection
- Random direction selection at intersections (up/down/left/right excluding reverse)
- Direction state tracking for current movement direction
- Handle edge cases: corners, boundaries of simulation area

Depends on base class being in place.
close_reason: Implemented in python/src/lichen/sim/mobility.py: added GridDirection enum (RIGHT/LEFT/UP/DOWN tuple values + reverse(), :672, member order matches historical scan order so first draw from a fresh pattern consumes RNG identically to pre-change code), _GRID_EPSILON=1e-9 (:670), public detect_intersection(x, y) (:761) with _on_grid_line helper (both-axes-on-grid-lines = intersection, mid-segment excluded), _direction state field (:724) set on every pick, persisted across arrivals, cleared on reset; _pick_next_cell (:838) now scans GridDirection, filters in-bounds, excludes reverse of current direction when alternatives exist (forced U-turn at dead ends/corners), single RNG choice per pick. step() unchanged. Tests in tests/sim/test_manhattan_grid.py TestManhattanGridDirections (12 new): intersection detection on-grid vs mid-segment vs tolerance, no-reverse over 50 seeds, one-wide-corridor no-reverse + forced U-turn at dead end, corner reverse-exclusion + first-visit candidate set, edge 3-candidate set, interior 4-candidate set, direction persistence across 200 steps, reset clears direction. Targeted suite 44 passed (17 existing manhattan + 12 new + 15 mobility, all pre-existing determinism tests pass unchanged); ruff clean; mypy --strict clean.
